name: sarvam-n8n-workshop
description: Meeting recording in any Indian language → classified GitHub issues + Google Sheet rows, with Sarvam AI + n8n

scripts.start: docker compose up -d && echo n8n → http://localhost:5678
scripts.import: docker cp workflow/meeting-to-tickets.json sarvam-n8n:/tmp/wf.json && docker exec sarvam-n8n n8n import:workflow --input=/tmp/wf.json
